summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature in the repository without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) pairs computed by removing the padding offset; set_rnd skips names starting with "__"); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator, reworked GridPatchDataset with patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, np.ceil worker split, NotImplementedError for missing len(), apply_transform with map_items=False; PatchDataset docstring uses float); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds a PatchIter autodoc entry; tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array. Unverified: the pinned test values and the docstring example output were not executed. Judgment calls to review: setUp and test_loading_array both call set_determinism(1234); test images are np.arange(16) for both items, inferred from the pinned values. Remaining over-120-character lines in utils.py are pre-existing in get_valid_patch_size and were left alone.
